dogecoin.text: JUST IN: NYSE Arca has filed with the SEC to list Grayscale’s spot Dogecoin ETF, kicking off a regulatory review that could take up to 90 days, as Grayscale expands its crypto ETF offerings.

Grayscale has launched a new trust offering exposure to Dogecoin (DOGE). The company's head of product and research, Rayhaneh Sharif-Askary, highlighted Dogecoin's low transaction costs and fast transfer speeds, making it ideal for international remittances https://t.co/1R7z4M0eFt
Dogecoin Price Holds Key Support as Analysts Predict Rally to $4

ANALYSIS: Bloomberg ETF analysts predict a positive regulatory outlook for altcoin ETFs, with Litecoin (LTC) having a 90% approval chance, followed by Dogecoin (75%), Solana (70%), and XRP (65%), as the SEC moves toward clarifying crypto classifications.
RECENTLY: The number of Dogecoin wallets holding at least 1 million DOGE has increased, suggesting accumulation by large holders amid a broader market retrace, per report.
